description: This PHP source file contains functions related to inline editing of fields within SuiteCRM, a fork of SugarCRM. It includes functions for generating HTML for editable fields, saving field data, formatting display values, and handling related logic for inline editing features, access control, and field rendering.

methods.name: getEditFieldHTML
methods.description: Generates the HTML code for an inline editable form field in SuiteCRM, handling various field types and caching of templates.

methods.name: saveField
methods.description: Saves the updated value of a specified field for a given module record, with permission checks and different data type handling.

methods.name: getDisplayValue
methods.description: Retrieves a formatted display value for a field of a bean, with security checks for sensitive fields.

methods.name: formatDisplayValue
methods.description: Formats a value for display based on the field's definition, handling data types like datetime, enum, relate, url, currency, boolean, etc.

methods.name: getFieldValueFromModule
methods.description: Fetches a specific field value from a bean instance identified by module and record ID.

methods.name: convertDateUserToDB
methods.description: Converts a user-formatted date/time string into a standard UTC datetime string suitable for database storage.

methods.name: checkAccess
methods.description: Checks if the current user has 'EditView' access to a given bean.
